findings.title: Preserve the constructor supported by production dependencies
findings.problem: Starlette 1.0 removed the autoescape constructor keyword, so this module-level call raises TypeError when routes are imported by triggarr/__main__.py, preventing startup. Dockerfile installs with `pip install .` without uv.lock, and pyproject.toml leaves FastAPI unconstrained; FastAPI supports Starlette 1.0+. The installed 0.52.1 still accepts the keyword and escapes correctly, masking the production compatibility failure.
findings.fix_hint: Retain the explicit jinja2.Environment(autoescape=True) passed through env=, which both versions support, and verify application imports with Starlette 1.0.

members.problem: This diff removes the explicit jinja2.Environment(... autoescape=True) + Jinja2Templates(env=_jinja_env) construction and goes back to Jinja2Templates(directory=str(TEMPLATES_DIR), autoescape=True), the exact pattern commit e11187e deliberately replaced. members.why_it_matters: Autoescaping is the only thing standing between Jinja2 templates and reflected XSS. Reverting reopens the risk that a future Starlette release silently drops autoescape=True with no test coverage to catch it.
members.fix_hint: Restore the pre-diff code: build a jinja2.Environment(loader=jinja2.FileSystemLoader(str(TEMPLATES_DIR)), autoescape=True) and pass it via Jinja2Templates(env=_jinja_env).

members.title: Diff reverts commit e11187e and goes back to the deprecated Jinja2Templates env_options call
members.problem: The diff undoes commit e11187e almost line for line. In the installed Starlette 0.52.1, any extra env option makes Jinja2Templates.__init__ raise DeprecationWarning('Extra environment options are deprecated. Use a preconfigured jinja2.Environment instead.'). So the diff puts back the exact API the repo just moved off.

members.why_it_matters: Today autoescape stays on either way. But once Starlette removes **env_options, this line will fail at import time or silently ignore the option.
members.fix_hint: Drop this hunk and keep the env=jinja2.Environment(loader=FileSystemLoader(...), autoescape=True) form from e11187e. If the goal was to simplify, Jinja2Templates(directory=str(TEMPLATES_DIR)) with no kwargs also works, because Starlette's _create_env already sets autoescape=True by default.

members.title: Revert of deliberate autoescape fix reintroduces version-fragile XSS protection
members.problem: This diff reverts commit e11187e, which replaced Jinja2Templates(directory=..., autoescape=True) with an explicit jinja2.Environment passed via env= because the kwarg form routes through **env_options, which Starlette warns is deprecated. Verified on pinned starlette 0.52.1 that autoescape is still True today. pyproject.toml pins no bound on fastapi, no `| safe` usages act as a secondary guard, and no test asserts autoescape is True, so a silent regression would ship undetected.

members.why_it_matters: Autoescape is the only XSS defense in this codebase's templates. If a future starlette release stops honoring autoescape through the deprecated kwarg, every template would render user- and config-influenced strings unescaped.
members.fix_hint: Restore the pre-configured jinja2.Environment(loader=jinja2.FileSystemLoader(...), autoescape=True) passed via Jinja2Templates(env=...) from commit e11187e, and add a regression test asserting templates.env.autoescape is True.

members.title: Reverts the e11187e fix: passes autoescape through Jinja2Templates' deprecated **env_options
members.problem: This diff undoes HEAD commit e11187e, whose message says Starlette removed the **env_options passthrough in Jinja2Templates, breaking autoescape=True on newer versions. Installed Starlette 0.52.1 still accepts **env_options but emits DeprecationWarning. fastapi/starlette are unpinned in pyproject.toml. On any Starlette release that drops the passthrough, Jinja2Templates(directory=..., autoescape=True) raises TypeError at module import, so the web app fails to start.

members.title: Revert of commit e11187e brings back the deprecated Jinja2Templates **env_options path, and the unpinned Docker install can crash the app when it starts
members.problem: This diff undoes HEAD commit e11187e. In locked Starlette 0.52.1 the passthrough still works but raises a DeprecationWarning. Confirmed by running python -W error::DeprecationWarning -c 'import triggarr.web.routes', which fails. The Dockerfile runs `pip install .` with unpinned fastapi, so image builds pick up the newest Starlette. When a Starlette release removes **env_options, the call raises TypeError during import. routes.py is imported by triggarr/__main__.py and triggarr/search/scheduler.py, so the whole daemon fails to start, not only the web UI.

members.title: Autoescape now depends on Starlette's deprecated passthrough and default instead of an explicit Environment
